Name: Lillian's Hats (Json Assets) (Fashion Sense)
Author: ForestSleepUnderRain
Description:
Hey... It's author of mod...

As you read from the description, this mod adds some hats... For now there are 12 hats...
In future updates I will add more... Just be patient with me...

For this mod you need Content Patcher and Json Assets...

I hope I don't need to write how to install and uninstall this mod...

─────────
┆︎[Edit]﻿

Thank you for liking my mod...
I kinda wasn't expecting this, but I'm glad that you keep enjoying your game with my little mod...

There were at least 2 hats that I didn't put in this mod... I am still not sure about their design... If you're curious to see these two hats, then visit my  [url=https://ko-fi.com/liliansforest]ko-fi[/url]...

Anyway... Keep enjoying your game... And hope to see you soon...
